name: fathomdb-dev-tooling
description: Repo-wide dev tooling (markdown lint + link check). Not published. The TypeScript binding lives in src/ts/.
comment-scripts: 0.8.9.1: Prettier is removed from the root toolchain and must not return to the Markdown path (lint:md-format / format:md): its non-configurable *->_ emphasis reflow corrupts fragile markdown (see dev/tools/md-fix-corruption-ledger.md). markdownlint-cli2 --fix via the AST-guarded scripts/md-safe-fix.sh is the safe fixer.
comment-security: The root Markdown linter locks markdown-it 15.0.3, which fixes GHSA-gfr2-rv44-r23c. Preserve the AST guard and keep advisory provenance for pinned exceptions in scripts/pinned-override-rot.json.
